title: Marketing
directoryHelp: Search drivers by name, phone, registration, vehicle model or category.
disabled: Taxi saving is awaiting release activation.
onlineHelp: Taxi visits require an online sign-in. Save the arrival first; add bills later. Ordinary vehicle taps continue offline.
selectOrRegister: Select a driver or register below
explicitDriverHelp: Check the phone before registering. Choose an existing driver explicitly; shared vehicles never change the driver automatically.
guestAllocationHelp: Count each guest once. A second bill for the same guests can have zero additional guests. Enter a reason for a different bill date.
voidVisit: Void visit and its vehicle count
loyaltyHelp: One qualifying visit earns one credit. Twelve credits complete a card. Held or redeemed cards cannot be used for a new reward.
arrivalBasis: Arrival-date cohort; current reconciled net revenue and recorded incentives. This is not a payment-date cashbook.
emptyRange: Choose a valid completed date range.
coverage: {complete}/{total} guest visits fully reconciled · {awaiting} awaiting bills
currentBalanceHelp: Saved and redeemable card balances are current for drivers active in this arrival period, not historical closing balances. Partial billing averages include only matched revenue.
operatingScope: Successful Dine In bill headers and recorded covers; net sales after discounts, before tax. Other sales and P&L remain separate.
liveData: Today is live and incomplete. Ratios wait for completed sales coverage.
ratioHelp: A dash means the required data or denominator is unavailable. Per-car figures are period ratios, not a claim that each diner arrived by car.

errors.REQUEST_FAILED: Could not complete this request. Refresh and retry; no success has been confirmed.
errors.AUTH_REQUIRED: Sign in online to save a taxi visit.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Your role cannot perform this action.
errors.FEATURE_DISABLED: Taxi saving is not activated yet.
errors.ONLINE_REQUIRED: Connect to the internet before saving.
errors.INVALID_PHONE: Enter a valid Indian mobile number.
errors.INVALID_REGISTRATION: Enter the full registration (letters and numbers).
errors.LOOKUP_REQUIRED: Look up this registration before saving.
errors.SELECT_ASSOCIATED_DRIVER: Explicitly select the arriving driver or register them.
errors.IDENTITY_CONFLICT: This phone, registration or bill is already recorded. Look it up and review the existing record.
errors.VERSION_CONFLICT: This visit changed. Refresh its details before retrying.
errors.REVISION_CONFLICT: This report was replaced by another request. Refresh and review before replacing again.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: Retry information changed. Refresh and review the saved record.
errors.REASON_REQUIRED: Enter a reason for this correction or amount difference.
errors.VISIT_INCOMPLETE: Add a bill with guests and record incentive collection before completing.
errors.NO_GUEST_VISIT: No-guest visits cannot receive bills or incentives.
errors.DRIVER_UNAVAILABLE: Driver is missing or archived. Review the directory.
errors.VEHICLE_UNAVAILABLE: Vehicle is missing or archived. A manager must review it.
errors.REDEMPTION_HELD: Rewards are held pending manager review of a previously redeemed card.
errors.INSUFFICIENT_CARDS: There are not enough completed, unheld saved cards.
errors.OPENING_ALREADY_STARTED: Opening credits already exist or visits have started. Use an audited correction.
errors.REVERSED_PUNCH_IMMUTABLE: A reversed credit cannot be silently restored. Use a reviewed adjustment.
errors.FUTURE_RATE_REQUIRED: A new rate must start on a future business date.
errors.INVALID_AMOUNT: Enter an amount with at most two decimal places.
errors.IMPORT_EXISTS: A report already exists for this date. Review it before replacing.

prefixExample: For example: MP09, RJ14, PB10, HR26
diningBrief: {date}: {covers} dining covers across {bills} successful bills; net dining revenue {revenue}.
alreadyCounted: Already counted with a vehicle button?
gateDescription: Offline ordinary vehicle counting and online taxi arrivals.
modalSubtitle: Register taxi arrival, recognize returning drivers, and allocate guest visits.
newTaxiHelp: This vehicle is visiting for the first time. Select the vehicle category and register the driver.
emptyTaxi: Empty / no guests (Visit recorded, no incentive)
rewardReadyHelp: This driver has completed a loyalty card (12 punches) and is eligible for a reward.
noVisits: No visits recorded for this driver yet.
